title: </sub>  Treat the historical baseline as non-comparable
text:
</sub>  Treat the historical baseline as non-comparable

When a new run uses the current prompt/model configuration, this clause correctly says it cannot reproduce the 2026-09-10 baseline, but AC8 and its mirrors still call that run “baseline comparable.” Reusing only the fixture and five-run sample count cannot make recall or variance comparable to the historical 6–8/13 result when no prompt, inference, or immutable-model field is matched; any difference could come from those dimensions rather than the sweep. Require the record to label the historical baseline non-comparable and treat this solely as a fresh sweep-off/on control, unless the historical configuration can actually be pinned.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/90a694eabddd7a1d3a45d741c85e45d0c19df7b6/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
